name: Don't Leave
source:
A short visual novel in which a man, long stuck in an empty limbo, encounters a girl from his past who helps him recall lost memories.

[From [url=https://ozonikki.itch.io/dont-leave]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了一个长期陷入空虚边缘的男人遇到了一个过去的女孩，她帮助他回忆起失去的记忆。

[来自[url=https://ozonikki.itch.io/dont-leave]Itch.io[/url]]
